Surprise!

We’ve been busy at work on the second game, but we also wanted to give some love to our first as a thank you to all of you who have stuck with us. We hope you enjoy the quality-of-life improvements and the fun new content we’ve added. There’s no need to restart your saves either. 💕
AND to celebrate, we’re hosting an event in Discord starting Monday, April 20th, with giveaways and activities. We hope to see you there!
Hats For Pets

You can now put hats on your pets. Each pet has 9 possible hats it can wear. Once you collect or trade for that hat, it will appear in the ui. If you haven’t collected it yet, you’ll see an outline that hints at which hats they can wear.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/502ca8bd292ab6866c6ffe864c1203d65d5a6a14.gif"]
5 New Hats
Get your head into the Yakuans and Mograni lifestyle with 5 new hats. 😉
Tricorne
On The Grow
Bright Idea Hat
Shadowy Hat
Smartinator 3000
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/3e398573f2277b54c82f113b1ee97365a25b239c.gif"]
More World Interactions (Prosperity Spots)
It’s through your collective prosperity that the clan was able to grow. You can now interact with 3 more prosperity spots:
Resource Storage: Need more hardwood in the late game? Trade softwood or hardwood with Jag daily.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/39f8cff97edd6534eeab97befa2b0a9e7ed80594.gif"]
Washing Spot: Normally, Maeri does the laundry, but now you can do it too! Wash your clothes once a week for a charisma buff when talking with others.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/e5b5973af9257403d1969cdedd142fd7610e69ca.gif"]
Practice Range: Practice your aim at the range. You can play the spear-throwing minigame any time you want.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/5f61d2c19ccba03b887f3f130ac937f33c6c8c0b.gif"]
New Cutscenes
Get to know the stories of two more characters. Explore more of Nann’s backstory or get to know Nokk a little better with 2 and 4 flower cutscenes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/ffad780579625ddb2a928e3ec6dc0cd6525cfe1e.gif"]
Quality of Life Improvements
Naming farm buildings
Talking to Croll and selecting "manage farm buildings" will allow the player to name Animal and Storage Sheds, Breeding Pen, and Granary.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/e42daaa18f2e5839ea5fb6bf1f9bd658c656d129.gif"]
Additional Learning Station
Reaching 600k prosperity will unlock a fifth learning station.
Animal UI Discoveries Tab

Now you can track which animal variants have been tamed using the new icon below each animal's name in the Animal Discovery tab. Also, rare and legendary animals will show a different background color in the same tab.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/4a8ca63e63dcdc18c3d866436d4c1c08cc641a62.png"]
More Kitchen Storage Slots
House stage 2 expanded food storage from 16 to 40 spots, and after developing the cold storage idea will now be 96!
Cooking Collection
Now, the cooking collection has all dish placeholders from the beginning, including those recipes you need to receive in the middle or late game.
We hope you enjoy this little update celebrating another trip around the sun for Roots of Pacha. Thank you for being a part of that journey!
You Rock!
The Soda Den Team
Changes
New player hats
Pets can wear hats
Animal discovery UI tab now shows an icon for tamed animals and different background colors for rare and legendary animals.
New cutscenes: Nann 2 flowers, Nokk 2 and 4 flowers.
Player can now play the spear minigame at the practice range prosperity spot
Player can wash their clothes and gain a charm buff at the washing prosperity spot
Player can trade softwood / hardwood at the resource storage prosperity spot
Can add names on farm buildings in UI (Animal and storage Sheds, Breeding Pen, Granary)
Kitchen Storage Slots expanded from 16 to 40 and 48 to 96.
Cooking Collection now shows all dishes from the beginning.
Changed the number of learning stations that a player can get from 4 to 5.
Fixes
Player stuck in Glyp House cave in owl form with Glyptodon objects (To Deco).
Child with the Clothes Maker profession gifting the wrong item (boar fur instead of boar fur yarn)
Olla wasting water when moisture fertilizer is used.
Trees always drop the same quality of fruit.
Player clipping colliders when skipping the monkey challenge if they are in monkey state.
Missing relationships in NPC objects.
Yakuans Area 2 Lagoon Collider adjustment for Watercraft Spot to prevent player stuck.
Learning stations not showing days left sign for contribution points left.
Wrong baby animal name on Breeding Pen already Breeding Message for Traits.
NPCs stay visible during Tug of War.
Mograni/Yakuan NPCs stay visible during Tug of War.
General typos and dialogue text fixes.
Firepit’s fire layer being shown behind the object.
Dice Minigame NPC Rock Tiles being shown in different colors.
Koli being neutral about mushrooms' gifts.
Azkel and Voda not accepting player rejection after 8F cutscene.
Voda 4 flower cutscene music loop transition
Reese painting in other place instead of School in building state.
Koli appears in the Cave Painting Festival before meeting her.
Processing items icons adjusted to be displayed correctly.
NPCs duplicated while Player playing Amphitheatre.
Smoke signal not updating the days remaining for the Union event.
UI showing "not enough friendship" for animals when they are ready to breed.
Daari teaches no one when children are at the Yakuan festival.
Fishing Line Minigame Difficulty.
Player 2 stuck in bed if Player 1 makes an intermediate save.
Popup Lobby Overlay Error on Cancel.
Tayta’s shoes appear above her shadow when dancing, facing forward.
Gold Pot flowers appear to be floating in the air.
Wolf’s heart animation appears misaligned.
Reese wrong position at the Mograni Festival.
Wrong riding offset position for body 3.

This patch addresses a security vulnerability discovered by Unity, our chosen game engine, so we wanted to fix that as soon as possible. We also have a small patch on the horizon that addresses some bugs and QoL things. Thank you, as always, for being such an awesome community. You rock! 🥰
We’ve come a long way since first releasing Roots of Pacha almost exactly two years ago. We are so grateful to have such a positive community that has supported us along the way, so thank you!
The 1.3 Update is filled with mid to late game content, so there is no need to start over, that is, unless you want to.
So! What’s in the 1.3 update, you might ask? Spoilers beware!

After you complete the last challenge in the Forest Caves, Inza and Zeda will invite you to their respective lands, kicking off access to the new content. Then, once you complete the main story, centered around the Jungle Pyramid, the new areas will open even more!
After you finish the forest caves, Zeda will invite you to the Mograni Tunda once you complete her request. There, you will find three sub-regions, each a little different than the next.

Within the Mograni lands, you get to see Zeda, Touk, and Vallah, whom you may have already met in the 1.0 release, but you will also get to befriend 10 new characters, including one romanceable, Azkel.

You may have already traded with Zeda, but now you can also trade with other Mograni for a new outfit and decorations. And as before, once you befriend characters, they will send you a gift, including new hats and decorations.

You can befriend sivetherium, a prehistoric animal related to giraffes. Like some other pets, you can turn them into their adult forms with a “baby shroom” and ride these animals once you gain enough friendship. Then, in the icy mountains, you can find a new farm animal: the mouflon, an ancestor of domestic sheep.
As you explore these new areas, you’ll find lentil and rye seeds as well as dill, chamomile, and something called “soap root,” which you’ll need for a new Idea: Soap making.
Soapmaking

Jiyla will have an Idea that you can help develop for a new way to make soap. After finishing this idea, you’ll gain a new processor: a soap maker! With this contraption, you’ll combine soapsuds (made from soaproot) and herbs to create soap!
Fishing Traps

After gaining “bug catching” (more on that later), another character, Todu, will have an idea for Fishing Traps, a new way to catch fish. You’ll place a bug into the trap and return the next day to find a fish!
Dice

In the Main camp of the Mograni, you’ll find a cave where Cohh hangs out playing “Dice.” You can play him at this dice-throwing mini-game inspired by “Shut the Box.” A game that dates back to at least the 12th century.
Festival of Quro

Join the Mograni Festival of Quro on Spring 26 and get to know their culture a little better, and join them in a game of ball, one of their traditional games. Here you will play a simplified foosball against characters there. Then end the day with a traditional firewalk.
Once you complete the caves, Inza will have a quest for you that will result in you being invited to the Turtle Islands and visiting their three subregions.

You may have already befriended Inza, Brub, and Krak from the Yakuans, but in the 1.3 update, you will get to see them in the Islands alongside 11 new characters you can befriend, with one you can romance, Sayra. Like in the Mograni lands, you’ll be able to trade for a new outfit and decorations. Plus, these new characters will also send you a smoke signal gift once you become friends with them.
While exploring these lands, you’ll find a new farm animal, the dodo, which will drop feathers and eggs. And on another island, a possible pet panda who will call your hut home if invited.
You’ll find rice and grape seeds as well as calendula and sugarcane across these beachy lands.
Jam Making

When you discover sugarcane, Ash will have an idea for turning their “mashed fruit” into something that stays fresh longer. If you help her develop this Idea, you’ll gain a processor that will turn your fruits and “muscovado sugar” (made by grinding the sugarcane) into Jam!
Line Fishing

After you complete the main story and gain bug-catching (explained more later still). Tayta will have the Idea for fishing out on the lagoon there. Here you will play a tension-based mini-game to catch fish.
Music

On the main island, you can meet Solo and perform on the stage the music mini-game that is also in the Fall Carnival. As you play, you will earn “notes” that you can spend on more songs to play and collect!
Festival of Lune

Join the Yakuans on Spring 8 for a festival celebrating Lune. Here you will chat with characters, learn about the Yakuans, and play their traditional game, ball. Then end the day by sending lanterns to your ancestors.

After completing the main story that takes place in the jungle and the two new regions, you will get a cutscene that presents you with a goal and the new mechanic of bug catching. Here you will play notes on an ocarina to herd bugs into a single group to catch them.

To travel into the caves, you will need to heal sick trees by bringing them the bugs that they need. After they are healed, you can collect sigils that allow you to progress deeper into the new caves. And if you give them even more bugs, you will gain a sapling of that tree for a total of 6 new saplings.
As you explore the new caves, you’ll come across tokens allowing you to breed animals in a new way. Allowing you to breed cows, chickens, goats, sheep, llamas, and pigs.
Within the caves, you will be able to unlock a total of 14 long-lost seeds that allow you to plant crops like yellow carrots or curly kale.
As you complete the caves, you will discover more about this prehistoric world and how things came to be. And in the process, learn 15 cool new recipes!
Features
New region Tundra, where the Mograni clan live, with 3 subareas.
New region Islands, where the Yakuan clan live, with 3 subareas.
19 new befriendable NPCs.
2 new romanceable NPCs, Sayra from the Yakuans and Azkel from the Mograni.
2 new tameable pets: pandas and sivatheriums.
4 new plants: rice, grapes, rye, and lentils.
4 new gatherables: sugarcane, chamomile, calendula, dill, soaproot.
2 new tameable farm animals: mouflons and dodos.
2 Ideas for new processors: jam making and soap making.
2 Ideas for new ways of fishing: line fishing and water traps, with 18 new fish.
Iron working Idea and iron tools with greater power/range.
A new tool for bug-catching with a minigame.
30 bugs to catch.
2 new festivals: Festival of Quro and Festival of Lune, with a new ball minigame.
Mograni Dice minigame with skins and other rewards to be earned.
Amphitheatre minigame where you can play and learn new songs.
Sun and Moon caves: where the main story that finished in the pyramid continues.
6 new fruit trees.
14 new plant variants to discover inside the caves.
6 new animals to breed by discovering their trait selections in the caves: cow, pig, chicken, goat, sheep, llama.
8 final tasks for game completion, cutscene, and reward.
Added Special Deals mechanic when bartering with other clans.
38 new decorations.
2 new clothing options.
2 new footwear options.
12 new hats.
19 new dishes.
NPC minimap list filtering options.
Meet Beast in the Mograni camp if the Touk 4 flower cutscene has happened.
9 new Steam achievements.
Changes
Beekeeping idea now also accepts any item tagged as wildflower besides sunflower.
Bronze pickaxe power increased.
Thank you for following us on this journey. If you haven’t already, please leave us a review on Steam, it helps please the spirits of the algorithm.
Until next time!
You Rock!
The Soda Den Team

Hello Pachans! The 1.2 update and Xbox launch are finally here! Play cross platform with friends on Xbox, Switch, Playstation, And Steam! 🎉

In the 1.2 update you’ll be able to ride baby mammoths (and other pets), send your children to school, use an early watering system, and more! Read a detailed list about what’s all in the update in our Devlog 43 or peruse the change log at the bottom.
The OST also had a massive update with 35 new songs added! Listen on Steam or YouTube. (Stay tuned for Spotify)

Our game may focus on the past, but it’s time to talk about the future! We have a massive update underway with two new regions, fishing in canoes/rafts, camping, ball sport, iron, volcano caves, and more! Even though we’ve made some awesome progress it’s still a little too early to share. We expect the update to come out next year and plan to share more about it later this year. 🥰
Thank you all for the support you’ve given us. We truly couldn’t have done this without you.
You rock!
The Soda Den Team
Feats
Intermediate saves: save and resume the game at any time by going to your bed and choosing “Save at current time.”
Olla: an early watering Idea which holds 16 charges and waters the surrounding plants.
School: a late game idea where the clan’s children will go learn with Daari.

School learning station: after building the school you’ll get a learning station which can be placed in the fields affecting a 7x4 area. The children of the school will check it every morning to: clean affected sheds and talk to the animals living inside, water and harvest plants, refill ollas, pump irrigation pumps, harvest honey, and harvest trees. Up to 4 learning stations are available with higher prosperity.

Children new stage: toddlers can be enrolled in school to make them grow up to school-age children. Your child will get one of 4 personalities and eventually choose from 8 professions, with unique dialogue and gifts for the different combinations.
School-age children can wear hats, different clothes and you can also change their hair style and color.
Newborn, toddlers, and school-age children attend festivals.
Romanceables schedules adjustments to spend a bit more time in the house during the morning.
Added more dialogue for romanceables.
2 new Union locations: caves and beach, in addition to the existing Pacha Tree location.
Kiss your partner in your Union reception.
New dance music pools depending on who you dance with.
Partners, nannies, and school-age children can now use the seats placed in your house.

Added “Available to date” setting, which will prevent you from being asked to start dating in 6 flower cutscenes. The setting can be changed anytime in Settings->Gameplay and won’t affect your ability to use the context action “Start Dating.”
Added 5 new skin tones and 5 hair colors.
Quick “Transfer all” and “Transfer matching” items in storage boxes and inventory. New Sorting methods added.
Pets can be sent to fetch in different areas and bring back items from them.
Cave lions and wolves can grow to be adult pets by giving them “Baby Shroom,” which is obtained in Glyptodon’s Tree shop.
Some pets can be mounted: mammoths, spiders, adult cave lions, and adult wolves.
Animals in the village will show an arrow when they’re in the tall grass area to make it easier to find them.
Animals can be fed alfalfa.
You can now put multiple items in processors (solar dryers, fermenters, etc.) by holding the main action button. It also works when picking up the produced items.
Processors can now be removed while producing with a confirmation.
New Village subcategory under Journal to show the prosperity objects and the players’ lifetime contribution.
A button was added in Settings->Exit to take a screenshot without the UI.
Trap locations now show on the map after interacting with them and show whether they have a trap and if it’s ready.
Jag will now ask you if you want to go with him to the festivals that can be reached from the map: Competition Day, Clans Gathering, Cave Painting.
Cave challenges can be exited to retry later. They can also be skipped and marked as completed, although no achievement will be given in this case.
The unstuck button changes from a “Go back a few steps” to “Go back to checkpoint” when in the caves and now works when in owl/monkey mode.
The dialogue before using the forest shortcut to the village is displayed only the first 3 times.
Igrork’s nursery shows the current count of the selected seed in your seedbag.
Mounts can be sent to their sheds/herds/home.
Frer starts using the harpoon a few days after the idea is researched.
Vallah, Touk, and Krak will always go to the New Year festival if they’re the partner of any player.
New fishing mini-game UI
Added Korean language.
Added Traditional Chinese language.
Rebalance
Lowered regeneration rate for field debris.
Most meditation buffs will now last a full day.
Stone fences need 3 stones instead of 4.
Grob has some feathers and boar fur to exchange weekly.
Fishing consumes a little bit more stamina.
Animal sheds cost more at 750 contributions.
Fixes
Active Idea smoke signals showing in “Past.”
Riding points for players when racing.
Water tool executing water animation when empty and not targeting anything.

New fishing mini-game UI
Added Korean language.
Added Traditional Chinese language.
Rebalance
Lowered regeneration rate for field debris.
Most meditation buffs will now last a full day.
Stone fences need 3 stones instead of 4.
Grob has some feathers and boar fur to exchange weekly.
Fishing consumes a little bit more stamina.
Animal sheds cost more at 750 contributions.
Fixes
Active Idea smoke signals showing in “Past.”
Riding points for players when racing.
Water tool executing water animation when empty and not targeting anything.
Fixes
Cheese cloth sound leaks.
Newborns lost track if their needs had been fulfilled if a cutscene happened after crying.
Newborns kept crying at festivals and the notification showed in cutscenes.
Duplicated beds on a specific save/load scenario (this was related to not being able to interact with newborns).
Beekeeping idea could trigger before meeting Zeda.
Beech and Birch saplings had wrong descriptions.
Igrork's trees offered only a selection of trees everyday.
Cave painting festival not counting towards the pyramid goal.
Mounts sometimes lose their pattern color.
After moving a spot building the props (trees, rocks, etc) of the previous spot did not update.
Fish stuttering some times due to the the direction they choose.
Minor crafting UI issue using a controller.
Disk space check on PC/Mac/Linux version was hanging on some hardware.

We added all sorts of details to the 1.1 update like traps for meat, gifts from NPCs, new cutscenes, and more! Plus Steam players will be able to play cross-platform with friends on Nintendo Switch or PlayStation 4 & 5!
Steam badges and trading cards are now available! So you’ll be able to collect the Savanna or your favorite glyptodon! We hope these add a little extra fun to your playthroughs.
As always, thank you for all for your support. We look forward to continuing to grow and support this game.
You Rock
The Soda Den Team
Feats
New Year 2 animal, the aurochs.
You can now sit in decorations you've placed.
Voda is now a romanceable character.
You can now break a Union and form another one.
A new idea with 2 new processors a mushroom and herbs growers.
13 new cutscenes with non-romanceables.
NPCs will now send you smoke signals when you level up their friendship.
16 new dishes.
10 new hats and masks.
11 new furniture pieces.
2 new accessories.
Rebalanced tree fruit contribution cost in the pyramid.
Added a new tree fruit that prevents an animal from getting sick.
Added quality to fish.
Optional traps mechanic and minigame to get your own meat.
Optional overnight butchering animals with Grob to get your own meat.
Racing maps have been polished and optimized.
Japanese language support.
Cross-platform play between Steam, Nintendo Switch and PlayStation.
Performance improvements: load time, FPS, and memory.: Fixes
Minor visual bugs.
Minor schedules/dialogues errors.
Steam Deck now recognizes external controller and can work in docked mode (there's still a known issue in the library we use that will prevent reconnection from a disconnected controller)
Fixes
Players could get soft locked when opening craft tools and bartering menus from dialogue.
Building placement UI had inconsistent button behavior with the mouse.
Choosing to be barefoot still showed character using shoes.
Mount could enter storage shed, but it couldn't exit.
Animal variant was not marked as known in the collections UI when using rare and legendary pinecones
Jizu's exchange was missing Smilodon Claws footwear.*
Mograni and Yakuan exclusive pots were available in Reese's exchange.*
Pacha Tree fruits were visible before cutscene.
Couldn't talk to NPCs using the hammocks and swings.: * needs to pass a day to be fixed so the exchange daily stock is refreshed
Hello, Pachans!
The first step of the Roadmap is already here. The Quality of Life update is now live! There is so much fun to discover, like:
Smilodon outfit. We love fashion and know this new outfit will make you smile.
New romanceable NPC. Enjoy more cozy moments with Jag in three new flower cutscenes and maybe even form a Union with him.

Pacha tree fruit. Once you complete the Pyramid, you'll be able to exchange for Pacha fruit that grants different boons to make your life easier. Be sure to save a good amount of contributions. You'll need them.

+50 new decos. A set of new elegant decorations is available to exchange with Reese. You can make your home even cozier with the new pots, furniture, and lighting fixtures in bronze, silver, and gold varieties.
Moving buildings. Did you find a better spot for your home? Now you can relocate idea builds and your hut by talking to Croll.

Flower cutscene indicator. It can be easy to lose track of relationships when you're busy in the fields. A new cutscene indicator will help you know which villager is waiting to share a special moment.
Magic Hand Axe. Complete all the challenges in the caves to get this dream tool.
Jukk, the stylist. For 500 contributions, you can ask Jukk to refresh your style.
Obsidian mirror. Tired of that hairstyle or tattoo? This mirror is more than just an elegant home accessory. Change your appearance by interacting with it.
Your house, your rules. If you pass out in your house, you will still wake up there.
And more! The full changelog is listed below 🎉
We hope you enjoy the QoL update and have as much fun as we did making it. Stay tuned for more updates as we progress along the Road Map.
Also, if you haven’t left a review yet, we would greatly appreciate it if you would. 💖
You rock!
-The Soda Den Team
Feats
Jag is now romanceable.
Buildings placed by the players in the village can now be moved.
Change your character’s appearance by going to Jukk and later by exchanging for an obsidian mirror.
50+ new decorations, floors, and fences that will be available as you progress in the game.
New farm building: Storage Shed. An empty space to decorate or use for processing.
Smilodon clothing and footwear to match the current hat.
An indicator in the NPCs lists to show if you’ve met all the conditions and can trigger a cutscene with them.
A button to auto-assign seasonal seeds to the radial. Tools and seeds assigned to the radial can also be removed now.
A blueprint for a new tool, the Magic Handaxe, is given after completing the caves.
The tree at the top of the pyramid will bear magical fruit after completing the main story.
Jungle field has a tutorial now after completing the main story.
After obtaining the water wheel and befriending Vuak, you’ll be able to crush gems to color fires.
Dance while at festivals.
Name storage boxes.
Animals that a ready for shearing/milking will show an emote when you’re nearby.
5 new skin tones.
Added a “Grass Sprouts” craftable to regrow grass in the fields, available after researching animal taming.
The attune minigame can be canceled if no notes have been played, without consuming a charge.
Improved feedback in attune minigame when a note is not played on time.
Passing out inside your house will have you wake up there instead of in Igrork & Maeri’s.
Minimap can be moved by click+drag if using a mouse.
Move wall decorations instead of remove when expanding a player house or shed.
When placing/moving a building in the village, the area and any objects that need to be removed are highlighted.
Resulting quality is shown for items being processed in the processors menu.
Added lobby to start New Year’s festival in multiplayer.
Improved all translations: Chinese, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish. (tutorial images will be updated in following patch)
Updated credits with community manager, localization team, community testers, and backers who recently filled out their surveys.: Changes
Jungle field won’t allow fertilizer to balance and prepare it for its future use.
Rebalanced items' contribution values to make processing more meaningful, especially in early-game and late-game stages.

When adding vinegar to a pickler, it’ll now let you pickle multiple things, from 1 to 5, depending on the value and quality of the vinegar used. The resulting quality of the pickled product depends only on the input, not the vinegar.
The quality of a product made in a cask will depend only on the quality of the main product and not the hardwood, herb, or mushroom.
Harvest, tree, and animal products: increased their processed value for every processor, especially the early ones (smoker, drier, and fermenter).
Fish: decreased the contribution value of the highest-tier fish, decreased dried fish processed items value, and increased smoked, fermented, and pickled fish.
Fixes
Duplicated wall items when upgrading house.
Water Wheel adding quality to items that should have no quality.
Can’t water tree in pyramid with a multi-tile water tool.
Voda 2 flower event not hiding objects.
Locating NPCs in the minimap when in a festival led to errors.
Mouse not working when selecting/choosing to upgrade a building.
Visual glitch when kissing an NPC doing an activity (like chopping wood).
Some animal variant icons not properly assigned or missing pixels.
Some text was not properly visible when using Noto Sans font.
Tags not showing for some medicinal herbs.
Picking up items when in a menu could make an item disappear in multiplayer.
Bartering menu opens for everyone after finishing Zelk’s idea in multiplayer.
Couldn’t use granary and breeding pen at the same time in multiplayer.
Incorrect attune message for players who join a multiplayer game late and who don’t have a flute yet.
Duplicated interiors in multiplayer.
First cave challenge desync errors in multiplayer.
SFXs fixes and missing sounds.
Typos, dialogue, and schedules fixes.
Feats
Storage boxes and belts can now be auto-sorted by tags.
Improved performance of tall grasses in the Savanna.
Improved animal herd regeneration.: Fixes
Trading didn’t subtract more than 255 of the same item.
Prickly Pear didn’t look ready to harvest when domesticated.
Some tall grasses in the Savanna remained after cutting them.
Tag order was inconsistent between items.
Fences were invisible but still collidable in interactive cutscenes.
Torch buff not working when mounted.
Taming Steam Achievements used to count only currently tamed and not ever tamed.
Repeatable plants behaved like non-repeatable in the jungle
Ada’s sick animals quest finished before talking to her, making it impossible to craft medicines.
Some players were unable to water the vines in the last sand room.
In multiplayer, players were sent to bed, and other errors when joining a game after it had been paused for a long time.
In multiplayer, racing could lead to errors because of time desync.
Typos and variable injections.
Reported schedule errors.
Reported dialogue errors.
Fixes
Some players in the US are unable to host a room in their region ("Error: Can't Connect To Network Region.")
Changelog
Feats

Keyboard key bindings under “Settings → Gameplay → Keyboard Layout” option when playing with keyboard/mouse. Your key bindings are saved in a file named “keyboard-mapping.json” which can be shared outside the game.
Added a having children tutorial after the birth of your first child. It’s also available for players who already have children.
Romanceable NPCs are aware if either of you is in a Union when asking you to start dating in their 6 flower event.
If manually choosing a gamepad, the last selection is saved for future sessions.
If not using VSync, you can now select a target framerate.: Fixes
Issues targeting stone boxes and processors when there were too many objects around them.
Couldn’t use right-click in the fields to bring up the context actions for the player (Eat/Dance/Drop).
Dialogues mentioning newborns were not getting the right variables.
The last upgrade for the Animal Shed thatch roof didn’t change with the seasons.
Multiplayer clients got stuck in a black screen if they joined a game where a scheduled event had happened earlier that day, like a birth, pyramid rise, etc.
Buffs not updating when just fully bonded. It required unequipping and equipping them back.
Southern field pathfinding errors caused animals not to go outside or cross fences.
Ores were sometimes not blocking a path in A Hearty Room.
Resources in the field now have square colliders to prevent getting stuck in between them.
The torch radius buff wasn’t working.
Wolf pack minimap location corrected.
Yakuans and Mograni were visible in a Union even when they were not involved in the ceremony.
Duplicated NPCs in Competition Day and Winter Festival.
Being able to pick honey infinite times.
Irrigation trenches couldn’t be removed if they ended up disconnected from a pump or extender.
Corner farm tile near the path to the beach was not interactable in Fall and Winter.
Tools that can hit multiple tiles were not being handled correctly for some objects, resulting in weird interactions, like kissing your partner after using a sickle.
Nursery seeds user interface placeholder information was shown at times.
Buffs UI visual and functional errors.
Myco fertilizer doesn’t remain in the soil if a plant is harvested in a valid season. It now only clears if out of season.
Some dialogue conditions.
Some schedule errors.
Some typos.: Notes: Translations for new features/fixes are a WIP. The new localization company is accommodating time for the weekly patches but will fully review them for their final delivery.
Changelog
Feats
A gamepad can be manually selected under Settings/Gameplay.
Firepits can now be placed inside.
Improved description for object placement.
Union Wreath blueprint is now always available to craft in a multiplayer session and changed description so it's more clear how to form Union between players.
Animal attune minigame now pauses the time in single player.
Added Backspace as an alternative button for actions like Delete save and Discard items in your inventory. This should take care of not having to press fn+Backspace in Mac.: Fixes
Improved overall performance, especially notable in end-game saves. We’ll keep working on optimizations.
10 flower cutscenes were triggering even if not dating forcing players to reject the NPCs.
Era 10 flowers didn't trigger at the right moment.
Buildings in map not updating their location after being moved.
Trees destroyed immediately after placing close to the edges if not aligned to the grid.
Going out of bounds after dismounting an animal.
White bars on New Years festival if playing in widescreen monitors.
Wood Yield buff not yielding more wood than not using any buff.
Caves vines not being able to reach with tools if there was a rock or something around it.
Children not growing up if not named after 14 days.
Gifts you’ve given to NPCs were separated by quality instead of being grouped by type.
Starting cave challenges after 1:30 am was leading to errors, it’s no longer possible to do it.
Some animal synchronization issues in multiplayer related to the spawn/despawn of herds.
Waterwheel not showing in multiplayer for other players when joining a game in progress.
Passout cutscene leading to errors in saving in multiplayer if one player stayed up in a UI or minigame for too long.
Monkey challenge music not synced in multiplayer.
Legendary and Epic animals stats were lowers than what they should be.
Legendary and Epic not spawning on the days they should.
Plant discovery Steam achivements not triggering correctly. (Make Igrork Proud, Make Ada Proud and Make The Clan Proud)
Cooking Steam achievements not triggering correctly. (Delightful Dish, Chef Of The Ages and Culinary Innovator)
UI visual issues.
Portrait visual issues.
Some NPC schedule overlaps and priorities.
Dialogue and other string errors.
Updated credits with backers who filled out their survey recently.
Changelog
Feats

Added an experimental setting to set the duration of a day to one of 3 options: 15 minutes (recommended), 17.5 minutes (long), and 20 mins (longest). You need to choose it before you start/load a game, the setting is found in the Main Menu under Settings/Gameplay.
Added generic gamepad support. This should take care of the issues some players are having with controllers not being detected.: Fixes
Random game crash/hang. It happened with more frequency in late games but also impacted the early stages of the game.
Waterwheel not controlling if storage was full to start/end production.
All seeds available in the nursery, even if not discovered, after unlocking the field in the jungle.
Golden pomegranate resetting animal friendship instead of maxing it.
Pausing the game with P could lead to time errors and exploits. It’s no longer possible to fully pause with P while in any UI.
Some NPCs were going to a rock near the central fire to start their “work” tasks while their buildings were being built.
Nearby irrigation systems would lock others when watered and prevented draining/pumping.
Placing the waterwheel was checking for nearby objects and could soft-lock players.
A recipe couldn’t be obtained after the conditions were met. Arroz Con Leche is now correctly given by the Yakuans.
Strange behavior when adding to a stack of items in the belts/storage boxes.
Item duplication in multiplayer when removing items in processors that need multiple items, such as casks and picklers.
Can’t remove small things placed in the wall behind the bed.
Wall decorations layered over some objects like the Pacha Statue in the last house upgrade.
Cat Pot limited drawable area.
Depending on the day, ores in the first sand room make it impossible to reach the torch.
NPC schedule errors and overlaps.

Typos and dialogue conditions.: Notes: If you're using an original console controller (Xbox 360, Xbox One, PS4, PS5, Switch Pro), we recommend you to "Disable Steam Input." You can do this in Steam by right-clicking the game-> Properties->Controller.
Changelog
Feats
Unstuck button in the exit menu.
Improved cave ore colliders to prevent passing through diagonally.: Fixes
Animal shed 2nd upgrade no slots preventing autograb.
Bear claws destroying ores and not spawning some minerals.
Items displaying {ParentName} in title and description.
Grasses showing in cutscenes/challenges where there shouldn’t be any.
Some rocks with higher hardness blocking progress earlier than expected.
A multiplayer cutscene could be started if other player was in a single player cutscene.
Frer in Union infinite gift dialogue.
Initial "Contribute 3 items" quest triggering again after completed.
Wrong sprites for some items.
Wrong names for some items.
Zelk is away trading on his birthday.
Changelog
Fixes
Animal shed 2nd upgrade not autograbbing from fur animals.
Wrong hint in final Glyptodon challenge.
Changelog
Fix: Infinite drop after picking something with your inventory full in macOS.
Fix: Animals getting sick too early in the game with no possibility of obtaining oil.
Fix: Duplicated house (or other buildings). If you had a duplicated house, you'll now have the most updated one.
Fix: Animal health and hunger was getting desynchronized in multiplayer.
Fix: UI still open when starting a cutscene.
Fix: “The animals of Pacha abounded” prophecy synchronization in multiplayer.
Fix: Dialogue conditions and typos.
Fix: Item descriptions.
Changelog
Feat: new smoke signal should trigger the first time a player adds an item to an already full inventory hinting that Jizu has more belts.
Fix: not able to order obsidian tools if the tool station is being upgraded.
Fix: object placement flickering in some resolutions.
Fix: most common places players were getting stuck (we’re evaluating adding an “unstuck button” in a future update).
Fix: animal racing can’t be started when it coincides with another event. Plus it’ll now ask all players to talk to Jelrod to start it.
Fix: Zelk won’t trade seeds that aren’t yet accessible to the player.
Fix: manage building action with Croll failed for buildings that were being built/upgraded.
Fix: achievements for dishes and processed items were not triggering on new games.
Fix: animal taming achievements didn't trigger immediately but until the next taming action.
Players can't create or join rooms after updating the Steam Client (Apr 26 2023)
Fixed multiplayer entities desync over days that made animals tamed by a player not visible to others.
Fixes stuck at saving issue.
Fixes wolf outfit code input adding an extra dash.

items.text: Dec. 14th 10am pt | 1pm et | 6pm utc

Join us for a live stream as we talk about the latest in development, answer questions, and set the stage for what the future holds. Don’t worry we only introduce the main story and won’t spoil it (we also hate spoilers).
We’ll be streaming right here on Steam, Twitch, and YouTube.
If you miss the stream we will be posting it on YouTube along with the written devlog a few hours after the stream ends.
Hope to see you then!
ps.
We just updated our discord bot community game, we now have fishing!

It's the end of the month, and that means it’s (almost) devlog time. But since it's also Alpha time, we're going to do something cool and stream the new content instead of doing a devlog. We thought it'd be a fun way to showcase the main features of this iteration and hang out with you, the community.
Join us next week as we explore the Savanna and take in the Summer sun in the Land Between Two Rivers. But don’t worry we won’t “spoil” everything.
The alpha update will be released soon after the stream ends 🔥🔥🔥 !
